purpose: a personal CLI to register named aliases for folder/app paths and instantly open them in Explorer, an IDE, a terminal, or a custom app.

items.title: Add / remove / rename / edit folder shortcuts (`add`, `remove`, `rename`, `edit`)
`list` table, `copy` path to clipboard, `check [--prune]` for broken paths
Command-line app shortcuts (add --cmd, Command kind in web UI) run in a terminal window
items.note: {app, terminal:true}; runs via launchApp('cmd', home, 1, line)

items.title: CLI: hasOwn name checks (constructor/toString bug)
items.note: done in web/cli batch

items.title: CLI: ws open reports failures and exits 1
items.note: done in web/cli batch

items.title: One name rule (no spaces, __proto__) for CLI, selector and web
items.note: done in web/cli batch

items.title: Auto backup
items.body: Back up links.json before every write, keep the last 10.

how: Copy links.json to ~/.upex/backups/links-<timestamp>.json inside saveLinks before the rename, delete all but the newest 10.
check: Smoke assert: 12 saves leave 10 backups, newest matches the previous file.

items.note: Backups in ~/.upex/backups before each links.json write, newest 10 kept. Skips usage bumps and no-op saves.

items.title: Archive instead of delete
items.body: rm --archive hides a shortcut but keeps it restorable.

how: archived: true on the entry; hidden from list, selector, completion and fuzzy resolve; upex restore <name> clears it; ls --archived shows them.

items.note: rm --archive, upex restore, ls --archived; hidden from selector, completion, resolve, last, open <tag>; web Archive button + Archived filter with Restore

items.title: Stale report
items.body: List shortcuts not opened in N days and offer to archive them.

how: upex stale [days=60] lists shortcuts by lastUsed (never-used first), offers to archive each.

items.note: upex stale [days] [--yes], y/n/a/q archive prompt, new entries get added

items.title: Aliases
items.body: Give one shortcut several names (velora, vd).

trap: Renames, remove, workspaces and transfer must follow aliases to the real name.
how: Entry gets aliases: []; resolveName and __names include them; nameError rejects a name or alias already used by another shortcut.

items.note: upex alias + add --alias; resolve/go/rm/rename/edit/ws follow aliases; clashes blocked in add/rename/selector/web, flagged by doctor and import; web edit field

items.title: upex stats
items.body: Most used shortcuts and openers over time.

how: Only uses/lastUsed exist today. Over time and per opener needs a small append-only log (~/.upex/history.jsonl: ts, name, opener) written in recordUse.

items.note: history.jsonl logged in recordUse(name, opener), upex stats [--days N|--all]

items.title: upex note <name> "text"
items.body: Short note per shortcut, shown in ls and the selector.
items.note: CLI note command, selector detail pane + edit form, upex ui shows it under the name and edits it

items.title: ls --dirty
items.body: Only show repos with uncommitted changes or unpushed commits.

how: git status --porcelain and rev-list @{u}..HEAD per folder, run in parallel; skip non-repos.

items.title: Web UI drag and drop
items.body: Drop a folder onto the page to add it as a shortcut.
items.note: Browsers only expose a dropped folder's name, not its full path, so a drop cannot reliably create a shortcut.

items.title: upex scan <dir>
items.body: Find git repos/projects under a folder and bulk-add them as shortcuts (pick which in a checklist). Fast setup on a new PC.

items.title: add with no name uses cwd
items.body: upex add (or upex add .) registers the current folder named after its basename. Most common add case, zero typing.
items.note: upex add / upex add . [path] names it after the folder, spaces as dashes

items.title: Pinned favorites
items.body: Pin shortcuts to the top of the selector and web UI regardless of frecency. Some projects matter even when used rarely.
items.note: upex pin/unpin, pinned:true sorts first in selector + web (pin toggle per row)

items.title: Temporary shortcuts
items.body: add --ttl 7d for short-lived folders (downloads, client handoffs). Expired ones get flagged or archived automatically.
items.note: add --ttl 7d sets expires, preAction hook archives expired (skips go/__*), restore drops expires

items.title: upex undo
items.body: Keep the last N store versions and roll back the last add/edit/rm/prune. Cheap safety net next to auto-backup.
items.note: upex undo restores newest backup (10 kept), steps back on repeat, keeps usage stats

items.title: Archived shortcuts in the TUI
items.body: The selector shows archived shortcuts somewhere (e.g. a tab or a toggle), so they can be seen and restored without upex ls --archived / upex restore.
items.note: Settings ends with an Archived section (A to Z); Enter or a second click restores one like upex restore

items.title: Open in Explorer / default app / VS Code / WebStorm / terminal
Multi-terminal open with optional start command (`cmd <name> [count] [start]`)
`claude` opener: terminal running Claude Code (`upex <name> claude [count]`)
File vs folder awareness (reveal file in Explorer, open file in default app)
Default opener per shortcut (add/edit --opener <app>, --no-opener clears)
items.note: add/edit --opener, --no-opener; selector preselects it; list shows it

items.title: upex web <name>
items.body: Open the project's GitHub page from its git remote.

how: git -C <path> remote get-url origin, turn ssh/git@ into https, strip .git, launchUrl.

items.note: upex web <name>: git remote origin to https (scp/ssh/https, creds dropped), CLI only, not a TUI opener

items.title: Windows Terminal tabs and panes
items.body: Open N terminals as tabs or split panes in one wt window. as a setting

how: config.json terminalLayout: windows|tabs|panes; build one wt.exe call chaining new-tab or split-pane with -d <path>; fall back to cmd windows when wt is missing.

items.note: config.json terminalLayout windows|tabs|panes; one 'wt -w new' call with new-tab/split-pane; falls back to cmd windows without wt. New Settings tab in upex ui (PUT /api/settings).

items.title: Terminal shell setting
items.body: Pick the shell terminal openers start: cmd, PowerShell, pwsh, or the Windows Terminal default profile (wt -p). Today it is always cmd.
items.note: config terminalShell cmd|powershell|pwsh|profile; PowerShell gets -EncodedCommand; profile + start command runs in cmd, no wt falls back to cmd. In TUI + web Settings.

items.title: Split direction for panes
items.body: panes layout uses wt auto split. Add auto, vertical, horizontal (split-pane -V/-H).
items.note: config paneSplit auto|vertical|horizontal -> split-pane -V/-H; setting only shown when layout is split panes.

items.title: Default opener setting
items.body: Selector preselects Explorer (DEFAULT_APP_KEY in interactive.js). Make the fallback opener for shortcuts without their own opener a setting.
items.note: config defaultOpener (openerKey-validated, fallback explorer) used by upex <name>, selector preselect, workspaces; files still open in default app.

items.title: macOS WebStorm gets a stray -R for a file target
items.body: launcher.js: on darwin webstorm's cmd starts with open, so it hits the system file manager branch and a file yields open -na "WebStorm" --args -R "<file>". Found by the edges.mjs review.
items.note: Out of scope

items.title: commandExists without spawning where/which
items.body: launchApp spawns 'where X' per launch (Windows ~30 to 50ms, not measured). Scan PATH (+PATHEXT on win32) in-process with fs instead.

items.title: Interactive frecency-ordered selector (arrows, fuzzy filter, in-selector add/edit/rename/delete)
Selector: Tab switches to a Workspaces view (Enter opens all, ^D deletes); terminal count moved to Ctrl+Up/Down
items.note: src/interactive.js view toggle; openWorkspace exported; smoke covers render

items.title: Subpaths: upex <name>/sub/dir opens or cds into a folder inside a shortcut
items.note: resolveTarget in fuzzy.js; open, go, __resolve

items.title: Selector: Apps tab for app + URL shortcuts (Tab cycles Shortcuts, Apps, Workspaces)
CLI: did-you-mean instead of listing every name
items.note: done in web/cli batch

items.title: upex config get/set
items.body: CLI for settings (upex config set terminalLayout tabs), so they work without the TUI or web UI and in scripts.
items.note: upex config / config get / config set, validation shared with upex ui via checkSettings

items.title: Default sort and view
items.body: Persist the start view and sort (most used vs A to Z) in config so the selector and web UI share it; the web keeps sort only in localStorage today.
items.note: startView + sort in config.json, shared by selector and upex ui (Settings rows in both; web sort select saves to config)

items.title: TUI fits the terminal: alt screen, resize, height, scrolling option rows
items.body: Alt screen buffer (setting to turn off, default on). Redraw on stdout resize. List rows = stdout.rows minus chrome instead of fixed 8. Opener row and Settings option rows scroll around the selection with ‹… / …› edges instead of hard truncation.
items.note: Alt screen (fullScreen setting, default on), resize redraw, list fits stdout.rows, optionRow scrolls opener/settings rows

items.title: TUI Esc clears filter first, confirms changes, ^z undoes delete
items.body: Esc clears a typed query before quitting. Green flash after add/rename/delete/setting change. ^z restores the last delete from the links.json backups.
items.note: Esc clears filter first (hint esc clear/quit/cancel), green success flashes, ^z restores last deleted shortcut/workspace unless name taken

items.title: TUI no dead ends: missing path stays open, prefilled edit/rename
items.body: Enter on a missing shortcut keeps the TUI open with 'path missing, ^e to fix'. ^e/^r prompts start with the current path/name. Long names clip with … instead of breaking the column.
items.note: Enter on a missing folder stays open with a ^e hint, ^e/^r prefilled with ^u clear, long names clip with … incl. hits

items.title: TUI mouse support
items.body: SGR mouse tracking (only in alt screen): click a row to select, double-click to open, click tabs, click an opener / settings option, wheel scrolls the list. Needs a hit map from renderInteractiveView.
items.note: SGR mouse in full screen only: click select/open, tabs, openers, settings options, wheel; readMouse swallows reports at keypress level; hit map via renderInteractiveView targets

items.title: TUI rough spots after the critique fixes
items.body: ^e does not expand ~ (~/x resolves to cwd/~/x). Emoji/CJK names: underlineHits splits by code point but Fuse indices are UTF-16, and widths use .length. handleMouse clears flash only on a hit, not on wheel/empty click. Missing badge set on a filtered copy can vanish after clearing the filter. Confirm-delete line and Settings rows hard-cut long names instead of clipping.
items.note: ^e expands ~; ui.width/fit/graphemes make layout, clipping, hit underlines and truncate column-aware for emoji/CJK; wheel and any click clear the flash (presses ignored); confirm line and option labels clip instead of losing y/n or the closing ›. Missing badge already survived via rebuild() reloading from disk.

items.title: Open upex ui from the TUI
items.body: A key in the interactive selector starts upex ui and opens it in the browser.
items.note: ^u starts upex ui inside the selector with a status line, ^u again or quitting stops it

items.title: Appearance settings: theme, accent, density, paths
items.note: theme/accent/density/paths in config; selector Settings rows, upex ui Appearance section (light-dark CSS, baked into the page), paths also in ls/stale

items.title: Script picker in selector
items.body: From a highlighted shortcut, open a list of its package.json scripts and run one. upex run already exists, this makes it discoverable.
items.note: ^s on a folder shortcut opens its package.json scripts, Enter runs one like upex run (tab mode keeps the selector open), mouse works

items.title: Reset settings to defaults
items.body: upex config reset [setting] plus a Reset button per section in upex ui Settings, so trying appearance options is risk free.
items.note: upex config reset [setting], PUT /api/settings/reset, Reset button per upex ui Settings section (off while at defaults)

items.title: Custom accent color
items.body: accent also takes a hex like #ff66aa: exact color in upex ui, truecolor in the selector (nearest ansi256 fallback).
items.note: accent takes #rrggbb (# optional in CLI); chalk.hex in selector, inline CSS vars with auto ink in upex ui, color picker in Settings

items.title: More sort options
items.body: Add Last opened and Recently added next to Most used and A to Z, in the selector, upex ui and config.
items.note: sort: opened (last opened), added (recently added) in selector, upex ui, config

items.title: Start view: last used
items.body: startView option that reopens the tab (and opener) you left the selector or upex ui on.
items.note: startView last: selector saves lastView/lastOpener on exit, upex ui saves the tab on switch

items.title: upex help: sections, wraps to narrow windows, shows settings
items.note: Sections, defList/wrap layout, Settings section; config list uses the same layout

items.title: Key hints setting
items.body: Selector footer: Full / Short (one row) / Off, frees rows for the list once the keys are learned.
items.note: keyHints setting: Full / Short (one row, fitted to width) / Off (no rows, no footer rule); Settings tab keeps its keys

items.title: Row details setting
items.body: Choose what shows on the right of a row: tags, badges (pinned, app, missing), both or none, in the selector, ls and upex ui.
items.note: rowDetails both/tags/badges/none in selector, ls (TTY only) and upex ui

items.title: Hide unused views
items.body: Pick which views Tab cycles through, e.g. hide Workspaces if never used.
items.note: Tabs setting (views): All / No Workspaces / No Apps / Shortcuts only, selector and upex ui

items.title: Max rows setting
items.body: Cap the list height so the selector does not take over tall terminals.
items.note: maxRows setting 8/12/16/fill (Settings > Max rows), default 8

items.title: Enter behavior setting
items.body: Open and quit, or open and stay so you can open several in a row.
items.note: Enter setting: Open and quit / Open and stay (selector only), also workspaces and ^s scripts

items.title: Pinned placement setting
items.body: Pinned on top always, or as their own section in the selector.
items.note: pinned top/section: Pinned / All headings in selector (not while searching) and upex ui

items.title: Multi-select in selector
items.body: Space marks rows, Enter opens all marked, ^d deletes all marked (one undo).
items.note: Space marks, Enter opens all marked, ^d deletes all in one save, ^z restores all

items.title: Keybind help overlay
items.body: ? shows every keybind in one screen, so the footer can stay short.

items.title: Reorder pinned shortcuts
items.body: Alt+Up/Down moves a pinned item; order saved on the entry.
items.note: Alt+Up/Down in selector, saved as pinOrder; byOrder + upex ui follow it; unpin drops it

items.title: Recent strip in selector
items.body: Last 3 opened shown above the list, even when sort is A to Z. as sub setting off by default
items.note: recentStrip setting (General > Recent on top), off by default; last 3 opened as rows under a Recent heading, not while searching

items.title: Copy path from selector
items.body: ^y copies the highlighted shortcut's path to the clipboard and flashes it.
items.note: ^y copies path/app/url and flashes it; Copy removed from the opener row (upex <name> copy still works)

items.title: Wrap-around navigation
items.body: Up on the first row jumps to the last row and back. As a setting or default.
items.note: Already wraps everywhere in the selector since the initial commit

items.title: Confirm deletes setting
items.body: Turn off the y / n delete confirm in the selector and the inline confirm in upex ui, since ^z undo and backups already cover mistakes.

items.title: Pin from the selector
items.body: ^p in the selector pins or unpins the selected shortcut.
items.note: ^p toggles pin in the selector (hint shows pin/unpin); pinned badge is now ★

items.title: Selector uses big terminals
items.note: Max rows Auto (default) fills the screen in full screen; key rows pinned to the bottom; detail pane right of the list at 140+ cols

items.title: Selector preview line
items.body: Show the highlighted shortcut's full path, git branch and last-used time under the list. Less guessing between similar names.
items.note: Out of scope

items.title: Show archived setting
items.body: Archived shortcuts hidden, dimmed at the bottom, or in their own tab.
items.note: Already done

items.title: Fuzzy strictness setting
items.body: Exact, normal or loose: sets the Fuse threshold for the filter and name resolution.
items.note: fuzzy setting normal/exact/loose: selector filter + resolveName (fuseOpts in fuzzy.js)

items.title: Search scope setting
items.body: Filter matches the name only, or name + path + tags.
items.note: searchIn all/names: selector filter + upex ui search

items.title: Flash duration setting
items.body: Success flash fades after 3s, 6s, or stays until the next key.
items.note: flash 3/6/key, Settings > Appearance > Messages

items.title: Tag filter in selector
items.body: Typing #web filters to that tag; a key cycles through tags.
items.note: Typing #tag filters (prefix, #a#b needs both); Settings > Groups > By tag groups rows. No tag-cycling key, #tag and web chips cover it.

items.title: Inline row actions on right-click
items.body: Mouse already selects and double-clicks. A right-click could show a small menu (open in..., edit, pin, copy path, archive) next to the row, so mouse users don't need the keys.
items.note: Right-click a row in full screen: box menu with open in each opener, edit, pin, copy path, archive (workspaces: open all, edit, delete); click or arrows+Enter, any other click/key closes

items.title: Remember the selected row
items.body: Start view Last used brings back the tab and opener but not the row. Also reselect the last opened or highlighted shortcut, so reopening upex lands where you left.
items.note: Not worth it

items.title: Command palette in the selector
items.body: Typing > in the filter lists actions by name (prune, stats, doctor, settings rows, open upex ui, archive...) so nobody has to remember ctrl keys. Easier than reading the ^k overlay.
items.note: Out of scope

items.title: Filter tokens beyond #tag
items.body: #tag already filters. Add is:pinned, is:missing, is:stale, is:app and @opener so the list can be narrowed without a Settings trip. Same tokens in upex ui search.
items.note: is:pinned|missing|stale|app and @opener tokens in the selector filter and upex ui search

items.title: PgUp/PgDn and Home/End in lists
items.body: Lists only move one row per arrow press. PgUp/PgDn jump a page, Home/End jump to first/last row (when the filter is empty, so the filter keeps Home/End for the cursor).
items.note: jumpIndex: PgUp/PgDn a screen (rows of the last frame), Home/End first/last on Shortcuts, Apps, Workspaces, Settings; Home/End always jump since the filter has no cursor

items.title: Empty start opens the selector
items.body: With zero shortcuts, upex prints 'No shortcuts saved' and quits, so a new user can't use ^a in the TUI. Open the selector with an empty-state hint and ^a ready instead.
items.note: TTY with zero shortcuts opens the selector on Shortcuts with the ^a hint; non-TTY still prints No shortcuts saved

items.title: Mouse setting
items.body: Mouse on/off separate from Full screen, so full screen can leave terminal text selection alone.

items.title: Stale after setting
items.body: 30/60/90/180 days instead of the fixed STALE_DAYS = 60 (src/interactive.js): drives is:stale, Settings > Maintenance and upex stale.

items.title: Recent count setting
items.body: Recent on top: Off / 3 / 5 instead of on = fixed 3.

items.title: Settings: regroup sections
items.body: Split the 12-row Appearance into List (Sort, Recent on top, Pinned, Groups, Max rows, Density), Rows (Paths, Row details) and Look (Accent, Glyphs, Web theme, Key hints, Messages, Full screen). Sort and Recent on top move out of General.

items.title: Settings: changed dot and per-row reset
items.body: Dim dot on rows that differ from the default; Backspace resets that row, like upex config reset <key>. Undo with ^z.

items.title: Settings: scope tag per row
items.body: Dim tui / tui+web / all on the right of each row, so notes drop the repeated 'here and in upex ui'.

items.title: Settings: type to filter and clearer labels
items.body: Typing filters settings by label and note. Labels: Enter -> After open, Messages -> Message time, Narrow screens -> Pane on narrow, Tabs options named by what shows, not what is hidden.

items.title: Explorer context menu
items.body: Right click a folder, Add to upex.

how: upex setup --context-menu writes HKCU\Software\Classes\Directory\shell\upex (and Directory\Background) running upex add <basename> %V; --remove undoes it. Windows only.

items.note: Not needed, Jenny decided against it

items.title: upex pick
items.body: Selector that prints the chosen path to stdout for scripts and pipes.

how: Reuse the selector, print the chosen path to stdout, UI to stderr so pipes stay clean.

items.title: Global hotkey launcher
items.body: PowerToys Run / Raycast / Alfred plugin that queries upex __names and opens the pick. Opens projects without a terminal.

items.title: __resolve exits 1 at once for command names and flags
items.body: Wrapper sends 'upex ls' to __resolve first; fastPath falls through to the full CLI (~190ms) just to exit 1, then runs upex ls again. Every wrapped command except go runs node twice (~380ms). Exit 1 in fastPath instead, saves ~190ms.

ASCII-only glyphs

items.note: Settings > Appearance > Glyphs (glyphs: unicode|ascii): ui.toAscii swaps selector glyphs 1:1 per frame, key hints spell out enter, up/down, left/right, bs

items.title: Bundle with esbuild on publish
items.body: Measured: ls 190ms to 137ms bundled (module lookup ~45ms is the main cost). Needs createRequire banner for commander, package.json/web asset paths, prepublishOnly step and esbuild devDep. Repo has no build step today.

items.title: Update notice
items.body: Check the npm registry for a newer @uplift-beyond/upex at most once a day, in the background, cached in ~/.upex/. Show one dim line after normal commands: 'update available x -> y, run npm i -g @uplift-beyond/upex@latest'. Never on go, __resolve, __names or the selector, never blocks or fails a command offline. Setting to turn it off.

trap: fastPath (go/__resolve) must stay instant: no network, no extra imports there

items.title: Package info in the detail pane
items.body: name, version and package manager from package.json in the folder.
items.note: Not worth it

items.title: Folder preview in the detail pane
items.body: Top-level files and folders, or the 5 most recently changed files, of the selected folder.
items.note: Not wanted for now

items.title: README excerpt in the detail pane
items.body: First few non-empty lines of the folder's README.
items.note: Out of scope

items.title: Openers used in the detail pane
items.body: How often each opener was used for this shortcut (VS Code 30x, Explorer 12x), from the open history.
items.note: Out of scope

items.title: App and URL details in the detail pane
items.body: Apps: whether the exe exists, its folder and kind (.bat/.exe/command). URLs: domain and protocol, big.
items.note: Out of scope

items.title: Usage sparkline in the detail pane
items.body: Opens per week over the last 8 weeks for the selected shortcut, from the history statsFrom already reads.
items.note: Not worth it

items.title: Key hints in the detail pane
items.body: On wide terminals move the key hint rows into the pane, freeing the bottom rows for the list.
items.note: Not worth it

items.title: Recently opened timeline in the detail pane
items.body: With an empty filter and nothing else to show, a timeline of the last opens across all shortcuts.
items.note: Tried it in the detail pane, not wanted

items.title: Marked rows in the detail pane
items.body: With marks, the pane lists every marked row and what Enter / ^d will do to them.
items.note: With marks the pane lists them (opener per row, missing in red, cut with N more) and the ^d line; goals and git hidden then

items.title: Shortcut note in the detail pane
items.body: A short free-text note per shortcut (upex note web "..."), shown in the pane.
items.note: upex note <name> [text] [--clear]; wrapped note row (3 lines max) at the top of the detail pane

items.title: Last touched in the detail pane
items.body: When the newest file in the folder changed ("touched 2h ago").
items.note: Out of scope

items.title: Same path warning in the detail pane
items.body: Warn when another shortcut points to the same path.
items.note: Pane row 'same path' lists other active folder shortcuts on the same path in yellow (resolved, trailing slash ignored, case-insensitive on Windows)

items.title: Stale hint in the detail pane
items.body: Not opened in 30+ days: a hint to archive it.
items.note: Pane row 'stale' when not opened (or added, if never opened) in 30+ days, with the upex rm <name> --archive command

items.title: Git change split in the detail pane
items.body: Changed files split into staged, modified and untracked.
items.note: Out of scope

items.title: Latest tag in the detail pane
items.body: Latest tag and commits since it ("v1.4.2 +7").
items.note: Out of scope

items.title: Goal progress bar in the detail pane
items.body: A done/total bar for the project's goals. only if it dosent impact performance
items.note: Pane goals row: green done/total bar, N/M done, open count; dropped excluded; ASCII # -

items.title: Partial goals mark in the detail pane
items.body: Goals already started get their own mark.
items.note: Out of scope

items.title: Last done goal in the detail pane
items.body: "last done: X, 2d ago".
items.note: Out of scope

items.title: Changed files picker in the detail pane
items.body: Click "changes" to list changed files in the pane, like the scripts picker.
items.note: Out of scope

items.title: Folder size in the detail pane
items.body: Size and file count, computed in the background and cached. only if it dosent impact performance
items.note: Walking big folders on Windows takes minutes (200k entries took 2+ min), too costly for the pane

items.title: Detail pane width
items.body: A narrow/wide setting, or drag the divider with the mouse.
items.note: Settings > Detail pane > Width: Narrow / Normal / Wide (paneWidth). Drag skipped by choice.

items.title: TUI: edit tags
items.body: Add/remove tags on a shortcut from the selector, like upex tag.
items.note: in the ^e edit form, Tab completes

items.title: TUI: edit note
items.body: Write or clear a shortcut's note from the selector, like upex note.
items.note: in the ^e edit form

items.title: TUI: edit aliases
items.body: Add/remove aliases from the selector, like upex alias.
items.note: in the ^e edit form

items.title: TUI: edit any target
items.body: Change app, URL and command targets too, not only folder paths; save a default opener (edit --opener).
items.note: ^e form: target + type for every kind, opener row

items.title: TUI: richer add
items.body: Add an app, URL or command shortcut, a typed path, plus tags/aliases/ttl, not only the cwd as a folder.
items.note: ^a name then the edit form on target

items.title: TUI: create and edit workspaces
items.body: Workspaces tab can open and delete; add create and edit (ws add).
items.note: Workspaces ^a from marks, ^e form with entries

items.title: TUI: custom openers
items.body: Add, change and remove custom openers (upex app) from the selector.
items.note: Settings > Openers

items.title: TUI: maintenance
items.body: check --prune, stale, stats, doctor, export/import reachable from the selector.
items.note: Settings > Maintenance: broken, stale, stats, doctor, export, import

items.title: TUI: archive instead of delete, wrapping key rows, ^k key overlay
items.note: ^x archives (marked too), ^d deletes only workspaces and Settings > Archived rows; full key rows wrap (^s, ^g last after a |), row count from the widest case; short mode ^k overlay

items.title: Multi-step undo in the selector
items.body: ^z only undoes the last archive/delete/prune in this session. Pressing it again could step back through the links.json backups like upex undo, with a flash saying what came back.
items.note: ^z steps back through links.json backups like upex undo, flash lists what came back; deleted workspace comes back first

items.title: Bulk edit marked shortcuts
items.body: Marks can open, archive and make a workspace, but not edit. ^e with marks: add/remove a tag, set or clear the opener, pin/unpin for all marked at once, one save so one ^z undoes it.
items.note: Out of scope
